"import cadquery as cq

# Local sketch plane: YZ (local u -> global +Y, local v -> global +Z)
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Regular hexagon vertices given in LOCAL sketch coordinates (mm)
pts_local = [
    (-38.615146, -15.721934),
    (-14.65608, -33.776385),
    (12.959065, -22.054451),
    (16.615146, 7.721934),
    (-7.34392, 25.776385),
    (-34.959065, 14.054451),
]

# Map local (u, v) coordinates to world coordinates on the YZ plane
world_pts = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for (u, v) in pts_local]

# Build exactly 6 line edges forming one closed loop
edges = []
n = len(world_pts)
for i in range(n):
    a = world_pts[i]
    b = world_pts[(i + 1) % n]
    edges.append(cq.Edge.makeLine(a, b))

# Export the 6 edges as a compound to STEP
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
